Introduction

Sunny Hill is a female trio under Kiya Music. Originally formed by For Everyone Media, they debuted as a co-ed trio on September 20, 2007, with their first single, "Love Letter". The original lineup consisted of Seungah (now known as Bitna), Janghyun, and Jubi.

The trio left For Everyone Media in 2010 and joined Nega Network. While there, member Kota was added to the group, and Sunny Hill participated in Brown Eyed Girls member Narsha's song "Mamma Mia". In 2011, Misung was added to the group, and the five members left Nega Network to sign with FAVE Entertainment. They released their first mini album, "Midnight Circus", as a five-member group in June 2011.

During promotions for "The Grasshoppers" in 2012, Janghyun went on hiatus to fulfill his mandatory military service. Upon his return, he officially announced his departure from the group in early 2014. Sunny Hill officially became a girl group and continued promoting under FAVE Entertainment until 2017, when their contracts ended. Jubi and Misung left the group in 2018, with Misung continuing to contribute behind the scenes as a lyricist.

Sunny Hill signed with BOD Entertainment in 2019. With the addition of Eunju and Geonhee, the group released their third mini album "NomNomNom" on October 25, 2019. From 2020 to 2022, the group promoted as a duo consisting of Bitna and Kota. Former members Misung and Jubi occasionally appeared with the duo before Eunju and Geonhee officially resumed activities with the group in October 2022.

The group began promoting as a trio without Kota in July of 2023. Kota later announced her departure from the group on April 26, 2024. Sunny Hill made their first official comeback as a trio on May 22, 2024, with the digital single "You Walk, I'll Run".
